verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only incident.io's own MCP server, which lets external AI assistants query incident data. That is the server role, not the ability to plug third-party MCP servers into incident.io. Investigations gather context from many sources, but nothing shows that incident.io's agent can consume tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
